facts.title: pasta with pesto genovese
ingredients: 1 pound (455 grams) dried pasta, any shape (shown here: gemelli ; more traditional: trofie )
2 ounces (55 grams) aged parmesan or pecorino romano
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Heaped 4 cups fresh basil leaves (3 ounces or 85 grams), from approximately a 5-6-ounce bundle with stems
1/2 cup (120 ml) olive oil, plus more as needed
facts.yield_text: Makes 1 cup pesto for 1 pound dried pasta; serves 4 to 8;
facts.author: Deb Perelman
